meta.title: Careers | Plasma Engineer Hiring | StarThermaTech
meta.description: StarThermaTech is hiring plasma engineers to design, test, and deliver low-temperature plasma diagnostics and electric propulsion measurement solutions. Send CV to bd@starthermatech.com.
meta.keywords: hiring, plasma engineer, electric propulsion, diagnostics, R&D
title: Careers
intro: We are looking for talented professionals. If you are passionate about plasma physics, send us your resume.
jobs.plasma.title: Plasma Engineer (Product R&D)
jobs.plasma.tagline: Own design optimization, testing, and system integration for plasma products.
jobs.plasma.work.title: Responsibilities:
jobs.plasma.work.item1: Design optimization, testing, and system integration for plasma products per requirements;
jobs.plasma.work.item2: Prepare and maintain related technical documentation;
jobs.plasma.work.item3: Collaborate with software/hardware teammates to resolve R&D issues.
jobs.plasma.require.title: Requirements:
jobs.plasma.require.item1: Master's degree or above in low-temperature plasma physics, gas discharge, electric propulsion, hollow cathode materials, or related fields;
jobs.plasma.require.item2: 3+ years of experience (graduate research counted equivalently);
jobs.plasma.require.item3: Familiar with low-temperature plasma/gas discharge theory and applications;
jobs.plasma.require.item5: Experience in plasma technology, diagnostics, or related engineering projects;
jobs.plasma.require.item6: Language: HSK Level 6 or TOEFL iBT 105+ (required).
jobs.plasma.prefer.title: Nice to have:
jobs.plasma.prefer.item1: Expertise in a specific electric propulsion application;
jobs.plasma.prefer.item2: Experience developing or applying plasma diagnostic probes;
jobs.plasma.prefer.item4: Background in aerospace or plasma applications.
jobs.plasma.keywords: Keywords: low-temperature plasma · gas discharge · electric propulsion · hollow cathode · plasma probe
jobs.plasma.cta: Send CV to {{email}}, subject “Plasma Engineer - Your Name”.
jobs.hardware.title: Hardware Engineer (Sensor R&D)
jobs.hardware.tagline: Design and optimize electronics for plasma measurement sensors; component selection and system integration.
jobs.hardware.work.title: Responsibilities:
jobs.hardware.work.item1: Design/optimize electronics for plasma measurement sensors; component selection and integration;
jobs.hardware.work.item2: Optimize electronics for other measurement devices;
jobs.hardware.work.item4: Install and debug electrical systems for products;
jobs.hardware.work.item5: Work with mechanical and software teams to deliver new products.
jobs.hardware.require.title: Requirements:
jobs.hardware.require.item1: Bachelor’s degree or above (or equivalent ability) in electronics, electrical automation, measurement & instrumentation, or related majors;
jobs.hardware.require.item2: 3+ years of experience (graduate research counted equivalently);
jobs.hardware.require.item3: Skilled in analog/digital circuit debugging; solid low-level electronics knowledge;
jobs.hardware.require.item4: Proficient with eplan or similar design tools;
jobs.hardware.require.item5: Able to design, select, and integrate circuits independently;
jobs.hardware.require.item6: Solid foundation and experience in hardware circuit design;
jobs.hardware.require.item7: Language: HSK Level 6 or TOEFL iBT 105+ (required).
jobs.hardware.prefer.title: Nice to have:
jobs.hardware.prefer.item1: Familiar with Ethernet, RS232/485, CAN, USB protocols;
jobs.hardware.prefer.item2: Experience with PLC/LabVIEW or similar host systems;
jobs.hardware.keywords: Keywords: hardware engineer · circuit design · aerospace
jobs.hardware.cta: Send CV to {{email}}, subject “Hardware Engineer - Your Name”.
jobs.power.title: Space Power Electronics Engineer (Power Electronics)
jobs.power.tagline: Design and optimize power supply hardware from concept through prototyping and iterative refinement.
jobs.power.work.title: Responsibilities:
jobs.power.work.item1: Participate in power supply hardware product design and implementation, covering requirements understanding, solution evaluation, prototype debugging, and iterative optimization
jobs.power.work.item2: Design switching power supply circuits including component selection, schematic/PCB design, prototype debugging, issue diagnosis and resolution
jobs.power.work.item3: Support product-level testing and verification (efficiency, ripple, dynamic response, reliability), deliver design and test documentation
jobs.power.work.item4: Collaborate with structure, process, and testing teams to deliver projects on schedule and continuously improve manufacturability and maintainability
jobs.power.work.item5: Track industry solutions and components to continuously improve product performance and engineering maturity
jobs.power.require.title: Requirements:
jobs.power.require.item1: Bachelor's degree or above in electrical engineering, electronics, automation, power electronics, or related fields
jobs.power.require.item2: R&D experience in switching power supplies/power electronics, capable of independently driving hardware design and debugging
jobs.power.require.item3: Familiar with common power supply topologies and control methods, with practical understanding of stability, noise/ripple, protection strategies
jobs.power.require.item4: Proficient in at least one EDA tool for schematic and PCB design (e.g., Altium/AD), with good layout/routing practices
jobs.power.require.item5: Strong hands-on debugging and problem analysis skills, capable of using oscilloscope, electronic load, power supply, multimeter, and other common instruments
jobs.power.require.item6: Good documentation habits and communication/collaboration skills
jobs.power.prefer.title: Nice to have:
jobs.power.prefer.item3: Magnetic component design/evaluation or thermal design experience
jobs.power.prefer.item4: Mass production introduction or engineering delivery experience (DFM/DFT, process collaboration)
jobs.power.offer.title: We Offer:
jobs.power.offer.item1: Participate in challenging power product R&D projects
jobs.power.offer.item2: High growth potential with full-loop exposure (design-debug-verification-engineering)
jobs.power.offer.item3: Competitive salary negotiable based on skills and experience
jobs.power.keywords: Keywords: switching power supply · power electronics · PCB design · space power · EMI/EMC
jobs.power.cta: Send CV to {{email}}, subject \"Power Engineer - Your Name\".
